name: Dyotanya
summary: A warm-paper editorial style with huge thin serif headings, mixed roman and italic emphasis, Manrope UI text, dusty-blue borders, coral inline links, circular imagery, hand-drawn black SVG lines, and hard charcoal offset shadows.
dos: Use warm paper for the page canvas.
Use Simeiz-style serif for all large display text.
Mix roman and italic words inside display headlines.
Use hard offset shadows instead of soft drop shadows.
Use dusty-blue borders on cards and inputs.
Use coral only for inline links.
Draw decorative lines as inline SVG paths.
donts: Do not use pure white as the page background.
Do not use blur, glow, or soft alpha shadows.
Do not use Manrope for large headings.
Do not use coral as a button background or border.
Do not use sharp corners on interactive elements.
Do not lock the hero into a rigid two-column grid.
